behavior: A non-draft PR (not dependabot, not release-please) gets a PR-Agent review; the guard step goes green when the marker comment exists.
verification: python3 -c "import yaml;w=yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/pr-agent.yml'));s=[x['name'] for x in w['jobs']['review']['steps']];assert 'Fail if no review was published' in s and s[0]=='PR-Agent'"

behavior: Config and registry parse together; the guard marker is declared under github-actions.
verification: python3 -c "import tomllib,yaml,json;t=tomllib.load(open('.pr_agent.toml','rb'));d=json.load(open('harness/review-attestation.json'));assert 'mimo-v2.5' in t['config']['model'];assert [r['review_markers'][0] for r in d['reviewers'] if r['login']=='github-actions']==['## PR Reviewer Guide']"
